prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 30s goddess, glamour hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, sleek slicked-back chocolate brown hair — wearing nothing but a neon pink glossy high-cut bodysuit with a deep front zip pulled open down to the navel and high-cut leg openings rising to the hip bones, every other part of her body, her shoulders, arms, stomach, thighs, legs, face and hands, plain bare real skin. Real photographic skin across her whole body, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The outfit sits on her skin with soft highlights, her skin tone running naturally everywhere else. Pose: standing facing the camera straight on, her left hand resting on her hip and her right arm relaxed at her side, her legs fully in view — most extreme glamour hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy old blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each longer than her middle finger, in old blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: mirror-bright glass skin dripping with wet liquid shine, blinding liquid highlighter across the cheekbones, nose bridge, forehead and chin, a flushed dewy blush, mirror-gloss lips.

Background: a bright airy airport terminal hall with a glossy pale floor, floor-to-ceiling windows, standard-height doors and a row of seats, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. A tall full-length mirror in a slim black frame stands right beside her, angled toward the camera so her entire reflection is fully visible in it. The reflection shows the true self of the same woman: her whole body from the shoulders to the ankles painted edge to edge in intensely glowing UV neon patterns, fluorescent violet, electric blue and hot pink lines blazing brightly against the dark, her face and neck bare living skin, in the identical pose and the identical towering heels. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the mirror beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, the reflection being part of that same photograph, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
